provenance.physical_gpu_cluster_measurement: not_measured (no 32-GPU H100/H200 cluster was provisioned during this run)
provenance.local_cpu_harness_measurement: measured (deterministic Roofline model and unit tests executed locally on CPU)
notes: Model baseline: 70B-class Transformer (80 layers, hidden=8192, H_q=64, H_kv=8, head_dim=128) on H100/H200 SXM (900 GB/s NVLink intra-node, 400 Gbps RDMA inter-node, $2.50/GPU*h).
All TTFT, KV memory, and cost metrics are deterministic synthetic outputs from this script and must not be cited as live multi-node GPU benchmark measurements.

scenarios.name: Single-Node TP=8 + FlashAttention-3 (WGMMA + TMA Ping-Pong)
scenarios.max_sp_degree_limit: Limited to 1 node (TP=8); quadratic O(L^2) compute & KV memory wall at >=256K

scenarios.name: DeepSpeed-Ulysses SP=8 (Intra-Node NVLink All-to-All on Attention Heads)
scenarios.max_sp_degree_limit: Hard capped by GQA KV heads (N <= H_kv = 8 without KV replication)

scenarios.name: 2D Unified Sequence Parallelism (USP: Ulysses-8 Intra-Node x Striped Ring-4 Inter-Node)
scenarios.max_sp_degree_limit: Breaks H_kv=8 wall via 2D (Ulysses on NVLink x Causal Striped Ring over 400G RDMA)

scenarios.name: Sparse / Linear-Hybrid Attention (MLA + Native Sparse Attention / 3:1 GDN + CP=16)
scenarios.max_sp_degree_limit: Sub-quadratic O(L * k) compute + 75% KV compression; scales to 1M+ on 16 GPUs

perturbation_checks.check: GQA KV-Head Ceiling (Scaling Ulysses from SP=8 to SP=32 when H_kv=8)
perturbation_checks.perturbed_metric: SP=32 requires 4x KV head replication (+300% KV comm & memory)
perturbation_checks.delta_points: Must switch to 2D USP (Ulysses-8 x Striped Ring-4) above N = H_kv

perturbation_checks.check: Causal Triangle Load Imbalance (Standard Ring vs Striped Ring Attention)
perturbation_checks.original_metric: Standard Ring Attention (Rank 0 idle 50% of causal mask steps)
perturbation_checks.perturbed_metric: Striped / Zig-Zag Ring Attention (round-robin token striping across ranks)

perturbation_checks.check: Exact Retrieval vs Sparse Hybrid on 128K RULER / Needle-in-a-Haystack
perturbation_checks.perturbed_metric: MLA + NSA / 3:1 GDN Hybrid CP=16 (99.4% retention, 3.20s @ 1M)
perturbation_checks.delta_points: -0.6 pts RULER retention for 4.56x faster 1M TTFT & -87.5% cost
